assertions.subject: Infectious spondylodiscitis
assertions.predicate: infection of the vertebral bodies and intervertebral discs
assertions.quote: Infectious spondylodiscitis, also known as vertebral osteomyelitis, is defined as an infection of the vertebral bodies and intervertebral discs, caused by pyogenic bacteria.

assertions.subject: Infectious spondylodiscitis
assertions.quote: It is a severe condition, oftentimes leading to hospitalization, and causing significant morbidity and mortality.
